signal: XOi raised $230M from KKR, acquired Specifx, and launched its AI-driven Advisor product to help field-service sales teams complete site surveys and quote faster

email.body1:
Patrick, saw XOi close the $230M from KKR, acquire Specifx, and ship Advisor to speed up field-service quoting.

After a raise that size, in-market accounts outpace how fast the team can act on signals, and the latency between a signal firing and a rep touching it is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for XOi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Patrick, quick follow-up for XOi RevOps.

Most ops leaders see the same drag: signals fire, but data hygiene and manual research mean reps act days later, if at all, and the measurable lift never shows. The fix is closing the gap between signal and first touch.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Patrick, last bit of proof for XOi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how XOi's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Patrick, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and integrating Specifx on top of everything else keeps RevOps busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I'll tailor it to XOi either way.
